Resolutions of 1967

12 resolutions, 100% unanimous. Decolonisation.

  • 233 (1967) The outbreak of fighting in the Middle East on June 6, 1967
  • 234 (1967) Demanding a cease-fire in the Middle East
  • 235 (1967) A cease-fire between Israel and Syria
  • 236 (1967) Violation of a cease-fire between Israel and Syria
  • 237 (1967) Treatment of prisoners of war and protection of civilian persons in the Middle East
  • 238 (1967) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 239 (1967) The recruitment and training of mercenaries in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
  • 240 (1967) Violation of a cease-fire in the Middle East
  • 241 (1967) The question concerning the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Zaire)
  • 242 (1967) A peaceful and accepted settlement of the Middle East situation
  • 243 (1967) Admission of Democratic Yemen to membership in the United Nations
  • 244 (1967) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
